The standard diamond clarity scale has `11 specific grades ranging from Flawless to Included` , as established by the [GIA Diamond Clarity Scale](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/diamond-clarity/).[[1]](https://4cs.gia.edu/en-us/diamond-clarity/)

### The GIA Clarity Grades

- **Flawless (FL) & Internally Flawless (IF):** No inclusions under 10x magnification, with IF allowing only minor surface blemishes.[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/pages/lab-grown-diamond-clarity-guide)
- **Very Very Slightly Included (VVS1–VVS2) & Very Slightly Included (VS1–VS2):** Minute to minor inclusions that are difficult to see under magnification and typically invisible to the unaided eye.[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/pages/lab-grown-diamond-clarity-guide)
- **Slightly Included (SI1–SI2) & Included (I1–I3):** Noticeable to obvious inclusions visible under magnification or to the naked eye, which may affect brilliance or durability in lower grades.[[1]](https://www.miadonna.com/pages/lab-grown-diamond-clarity-guide)

### What to Consider When Buying

- **Eye-Clean & Value:** Grades such as VS and SI1 often appear clean to the naked eye at a lower cost than Flawless stones.
- **Grading & Shape:** Grading relies on 10x magnification, and certain cuts like emerald cuts reveal inclusions more readily than brilliant cuts.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/engagement/diamond-education/clarity.html)[[2]](https://www.greenwichjewelers.com/blogs/journal/diamond-clarity-guide-know-what-matters-most)[[3]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/diamond-clarity-chart-grades/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IJioSelJOko&t=18)[[5]](https://filigreejewelers.com/blogs/articles/diamond-clarity-guide)
